notes: Menus and tooltips open out of the spot they belong to, and buttons dip a little when you press them.
Text fields and dropdowns look calmer in Dark mode.
Files you open stay linked to the original. You can pick several at once.
When the original changes, you can reload it. Your page and zoom stay.
When the original is gone, you can remove the file or keep your copy.
Show in folder, in the file list, opens where the original is.
Patch notes for this module start with this version.
